rules.description: Each feature gets its own directory with route.ts
Parameterized routes use Next.js bracket conventions
All UI components live flat in src/components
Shared backend logic and DB access go in src/lib
Tests co-located with implementation in src/lib
App Router pages and layouts only in src/app
API route files: route.ts (fixed filename) (e.g. src/app/api/health/route.ts)
React components: PascalCase with feature suffix (e.g. GeneratePanel.tsx)
Library functions: camelCase verb+noun (e.g. streamClaudeGeneration)
Test files: [module].test.ts or [module].integration.test.ts (e.g. generate.test.ts)
API Route Handlers files belong in src/app/api/
Application Service Layer files belong in src/lib/
Infrastructure Layer files belong in src/lib/db.ts
Feature Components files belong in src/components/
Pages/Views Layer files belong in src/app/
Application Service Layer (src/lib/) must not import from API Route Handlers (src/app/api/)
Infrastructure Layer (src/lib/db.ts) must not import from API Route Handlers (src/app/api/)
Infrastructure Layer (src/lib/db.ts) must not import from Application Service Layer (src/lib/)
Feature Components (src/components/) must not import from Pages/Views Layer (src/app/)
Out of scope: User authentication/authorization
Out of scope: Mobile or desktop platforms
Out of scope: Microservices or separate backend
Out of scope: GraphQL API layer
Out of scope: CI/CD pipeline configuration
Always initialize SQLite with WAL pragma via getDb() singleton; never create direct Database instances in route files (source: src/lib/db.ts — db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL') + singleton pattern)
rules.rule: Always initialize SQLite with WAL pragma via getDb() singleton; never create direct Database instances in route files

rules.description: Always export HTTP verb functions (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) from route.ts files; never use default exports for API routes (source: src/app/api/pins/route.ts, src/app/api/settings/route.ts — named export pattern)
rules.rule: Always export HTTP verb functions (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) from route.ts files; never use default exports for API routes

rules.description: Always mirror ClaudeTerminal.tsx SSE event handler logic in src/lib/stream-parsing.test.ts when adding new event types (source: src/lib/stream-parsing.test.ts — duplicates handleEvent, handleToolUse, TOOL_ICONS from ClaudeTerminal)
rules.rule: Always mirror ClaudeTerminal.tsx SSE event handler logic in src/lib/stream-parsing.test.ts when adding new event types
rules.source: src/lib/stream-parsing.test.ts — duplicates handleEvent, handleToolUse, TOOL_ICONS from ClaudeTerminal

rules.description: Always run tests with vitest run (not vitest watch) for non-interactive CI execution (source: package.json — 'test': 'vitest run')
rules.rule: Always run tests with vitest run (not vitest watch) for non-interactive CI execution

rules.description: Always use npm; no yarn or pnpm — project uses package-lock.json exclusively (source: package-lock.json lockfileVersion 3 present; no yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml)
rules.rule: Always use npm; no yarn or pnpm — project uses package-lock.json exclusively
rules.source: package-lock.json lockfileVersion 3 present; no yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml

rules.description: Always add 'use client' directive to components using useState/useEffect; omit for server-only layout/page files (source: src/components/GeneratePanel.tsx, ClaudeTerminal.tsx — all interactive components are client components)
rules.rule: Always add 'use client' directive to components using useState/useEffect; omit for server-only layout/page files
rules.source: src/components/GeneratePanel.tsx, ClaudeTerminal.tsx — all interactive components are client components

rules.description: Pattern: Server-Sent Events (SSE) Streaming — Long-running AI generation producing real-time progress
rules.when_to_use: Long-running AI generation producing real-time progress
rules.how_it_works: API route returns ReadableStream with text/event-stream; frontend reads via fetch + TextDecoder line buffering

rules.description: Pattern: Direct REST fetch — CRUD operations on pins, settings, presets, GitHub fetch
rules.when_to_use: CRUD operations on pins, settings, presets, GitHub fetch
rules.how_it_works: Frontend calls fetch() with async/await; manages loading/error state in useState

rules.description: Pattern: In-process function calls — API routes calling service/infrastructure layer
rules.how_it_works: TypeScript imports; no HTTP overhead; synchronous for SQLite, async for AI APIs

rules.description: Pattern: Callback prop drilling — Child-to-parent result propagation in React tree
rules.when_to_use: Child-to-parent result propagation in React tree
rules.how_it_works: Parent passes callback as prop; child invokes on completion

rules.description: Pattern: sessionStorage persistence — Preserving siteDir/sessionId/provider across page refreshes
rules.how_it_works: useEffect writes state to sessionStorage; useState initializer reads it back

rules.description: Pitfall (SQLite on Vercel): data/builder.db is written to process.cwd() which is ephemeral on Vercel; all pins/settings/presets reset on redeploy
rules.recommendation: Run locally or mount a persistent volume; consider migrating to Turso/LibSQL for production

rules.description: Pitfall (SSE line buffering): TCP fragmentation can split a JSON event across multiple read() chunks; missing the buffer = lines.pop() pattern will cause JSON.parse errors
rules.recommendation: Always use the split('\n') + pop() remainder buffer pattern as in ClaudeTerminal.tsx; validated in src/lib/stream-parsing.test.ts

rules.description: Pitfall (better-sqlite3 in Next.js API routes): better-sqlite3 is synchronous and native; it cannot be used in Edge Runtime or client components; will crash if imported in 'use client' files
rules.recommendation: Never import src/lib/db.ts in components; always access via fetch to /api/* routes

rules.description: Pitfall (Preset seeding): seedPresets() only runs once on first DB connection (checked via SELECT COUNT); manually deleted presets will not be re-seeded without dropping the table
rules.recommendation: To reset presets, DELETE FROM presets then restart the server to trigger re-seed

rules.description: Pitfall (Dual AI provider stream format mismatch): Claude uses tool_use event types; Gemini uses blocking response; ClaudeTerminal SSE parser only handles Claude event schema
rules.area: Dual AI provider stream format mismatch
rules.recommendation: Refine endpoint handles Gemini separately; do not route Gemini through the ClaudeTerminal component

rules.description: Trade-off: accept 'SQLite on local filesystem resets on Vercel redeploy' for benefit 'Zero-config setup for local development'
rules.accept: SQLite on local filesystem resets on Vercel redeploy

rules.description: Trade-off: accept 'Types duplicated between frontend and backend (no shared package)' for benefit 'No monorepo tooling complexity'
rules.accept: Types duplicated between frontend and backend (no shared package)

rules.description: Trade-off: accept 'No auth layer; app is fully public' for benefit 'No session/JWT infrastructure needed for local tool'
rules.accept: No auth layer; app is fully public
rules.benefit: No session/JWT infrastructure needed for local tool

rules.description: Infrastructure Layer changes impact 2 dependents: API Route Handlers, Application Service Layer
Extending 'AI Streaming Generation via SSE' requires changes in: src/lib/generate.ts, src/app/api/generate/stream/route.ts, src/components/ClaudeTerminal.tsx
Extending 'SQLite Persistence via Repository Pattern' requires changes in: src/lib/db.ts, src/app/api/pins/route.ts, src/app/api/settings/route.ts
Extending 'GitHub Repo Metadata Extraction' requires changes in: src/lib/github.ts, src/app/api/github/route.ts
Extending 'Dual AI Provider Runtime Switching' requires changes in: src/app/api/generate/refine/route.ts, src/app/api/generate/route.ts, src/lib/generate.ts
Extending 'Generated Site File Preview' requires changes in: src/app/api/preview/[...path]/route.ts, src/lib/generate.ts
